slug: 2025-07-01 Djibouti Digital Code adopted by National Assembly

facts.fact: Jones Day reports that the National Assembly passed Djibouti's first Digital Code, with an embedded data-protection regime, on 30 June 2025, still to be promulgated by the President and published in the Journal Officiel.

Jones Day reports that the Code's embedded data-protection regime establishes the CNDP; the document does not say it has been constituted, and frames the competent authorities as still to be operationalised (date is the Assembly's vote).
